O.outcome_detail: change in out-of-scanner n-back accuracy after 50 minutes of training

cells.quote: Consistent with the hypothesis that greater strength of dopamine system connectivity is associated with greater learning, we found that stronger resting-state functional connectivity between the VTA and the bilateral LPFC at baseline predicted greater improvements in accuracy (Fig. 3b, c: left LPFC: β = 0.067, 95% CI [0.011, 0.123], p = 0.020, pFDR = 0.068; right LPFC: β = 0.086, 95% CI [0.027, 0.146], p = 0.006; pFDR = 0.029), controlling for baseline accuracy, age, sex, motion, and total number of volumes.
cells.note: Measured association; the right-LPFC association survived FDR correction.
